scanpy-qc.question: Raw-count single-cell quality control in AnnData
scanpy-qc.method: Raw integer counts were evaluated using scanpy.calculate_qc_metrics. Cells were retained only when they met all prespecified feature, count and mitochondrial cutoffs. Genes were then retained according to the declared minimum number of cells. Doublet handling was {doublet_mode}; when requested, Scrublet used the explicit expected rate and score cutoff. Counts were not normalized.
scanpy-qc.result: Of {n_input_cells} input cells, {n_cells} cells and {n_genes} genes were retained. The cell-level audit retains all exclusion reasons; {n_predicted_doublets} cells were classified as predicted doublets. These are QC classifications, not biological findings.

scanpy-cluster.question: Normalize, find variable genes, cluster and embed AnnData cells
scanpy-cluster.method: Raw counts were normalized by total counts and transformed by natural log1p using scanpy. Highly variable genes were selected with the Seurat-dispersion flavor; {n_hvg} genes entered centered, scaled PCA with {n_pcs} components. The neighbor graph used Euclidean distance. Leiden clustering used the igraph backend with an undirected weighted graph and convergence iterations. PCA signs and cluster IDs were canonicalized; UMAP used seed {seed}. Counts and the full log-expression matrix were retained.
scanpy-cluster.result: {n_cells} cells from {n_samples} samples were assigned to {n_clusters} descriptive clusters. PCA and UMAP are exploratory summaries, not independent evidence of condition-specific effects.

scanpy-markers.question: Describe cluster markers without condition-level pseudoreplication
scanpy-markers.method: Cluster markers were described using scanpy.rank_genes_groups with test {test}, each cluster versus the remaining cells, the declared natural-log1p expression layer, use_raw=False, no effect-size selection and BH adjustment within each cluster contrast. All genes were retained in the feature table. Cells are descriptive units, not biological replicates; this analysis does not test differences between conditions.
scanpy-markers.result: {n_tested_rows} cluster-gene rows were tested across {n_clusters} clusters; {n_significant_rows} rows met BH-adjusted P <= {alpha}. These post-clustering statistics are descriptive and cannot be interpreted as confirmatory condition-level inference.
scanpy-markers.example: --from-run cluster_run --sample-col sample --counts-layer counts --cluster-col cluster --expression-layer logcounts --purpose cluster-description

scvi-integrate.question: Integrate multiple batches using a CPU scVI latent model
scvi-integrate.method: Raw counts for {n_model_genes} genes were modeled with scvi-tools SCVI using the declared nuisance batch. The architecture used 128 hidden units, one layer, dropout 0.1, gene-specific dispersion, a zero-inflated negative-binomial likelihood and a normal latent distribution with {n_latent} dimensions. CPU training used a maximum of {max_epochs} epochs, no early stopping and seed {seed}. Before/after UMAP and graph mixing diagnostics are descriptive. Integration changed the latent representation, not raw counts or original cluster labels.
scvi-integrate.result: {n_cells} cells across {n_batches} batches were represented in {n_latent} latent dimensions. Graph mixing is reported per cell and does not establish preservation of biological signals or removal of all batch effects.

scanvi-annotate.question: Transfer observed reference labels with scANVI
scanvi-annotate.method: scANVI was initialized from the hash-verified local scVI model. The reference contained {n_reference_cells} labeled cells in {n_label_categories} categories; {n_query_cells} cells carried the declared unlabeled category. Training used at most {max_epochs} epochs on CPU. Predictions used posterior means. Observed labels were preserved; full class probabilities and a descriptive cluster-label crosstab were exported.
scanvi-annotate.result: Labels were predicted for {n_cells} cells; {n_low_confidence} cells had maximum model probability below the prespecified display threshold {min_confidence}. Class probabilities are not calibrated accuracy estimates; no held-out accuracy is claimed.
scanvi-annotate.example: --from-run integrated_run --sample-col sample --counts-layer counts --labels-col reference_label --unlabeled-category Unknown --cluster-col cluster --max-epochs 50 --min-confidence 0.8
